text: You just won the lottery. And here's your choice: one million dollars right now — or a penny that doubles every single day for thirty days. Which would you take? After thirty days, the one million dollars is still just one million dollars. But the doubling penny? It becomes five point three million dollars. This is compound interest. It's when your returns start earning returns of their own — your growth grows on top of itself, over and over. Compound interest is a superpower that makes your money grow faster and faster over time. And here's what's really powerful: the earlier you start, the more it works in your favor. If that penny had started doubling just five days earlier, it would not be five million dollars. It would be one hundred and seventy-two million dollars. Stocks build wealth through compound interest. Small amounts, started early, can become truly massive over time. Bloom has a tool called Potential Return that shows you exactly how much your money could grow. Try it out.
